# F1-3/2e acceptance manifest — v3 (APPROVED 2026-10-22 by the repo owner).
#
# The runner REQUIRES this file and fails when:
#   - a listed fixture is missing (fail-closed: deleting a fixture cannot shrink coverage);
#   - a listed field is not asserted by the fixture that is supposed to assert it;
#   - a target case has no listed fixture.
# Fields that no case asserts are listed as `unsupported` with the reason, so the
# acceptance scope is explicit rather than implied. Extra .fixture files are reported.
#
# v3 added the guarded-contact case (with its flag-off legacy pin) and the shot-gauge case,
# and promoted `charge_gauge` from `unsupported` to an asserted field; the 2026-10-22 owner
# correction replaced its misattributed spend with the powered launch and the recovery rule.
# The runner's own
# required lists carry the same two cases and the same field, so removing a line here is
# caught by the manifest check and removing the constant is caught by this file.
# Companion: docs/PILOT-EVIDENCE-CONTRACT.md V3-1..V3-8 (V3-8 unifies the meter behind the
# pilot flag and re-pins the stamina expectations it changes; the denominator is unchanged).
